---
title: Trailing slashes are part of the URL
summary: One form per page, and a redirect for every other form. A test fixture, never published.
published: 2026-10-22
tags: [cloudflare]
source: https://example.com/url-as-ui
firewall_reviewed: 2026-10-22
---

Every page has one address, and it ends in `/`. The address without the slash answers with a
redirect to the one with it, so a link written either way reaches the same page.
